description: Department of Fiscal Policy -Excise Ordinance on Imported Malt Liquer (Beer) Imported Wine and any other Imported Foreign Liquer.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns regulatory matters under the Excise Ordinance, specifically detailing new excise duty rates, import permit requirements, and procedures for foreign liquor. It constitutes a statutory instrument/notification issued under existing legislation, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
